blocks.text: This holiday season, the Levi’s® brand embraces the idea that warmth is more than a feeling – it’s a way of showing up. With “Let’s Get Fuzzy,” the brand’s Holiday 2026 campaign, Levi’s® celebrates the textures, layers and connections that define the season, placing sweaters at the center of a holiday wardrobe built for both self-expression and togetherness. Rooted in the belief that it’s cool to be warm, “Let’s Get Fuzzy” reimagines holiday dressing through a playful and unexpected lens. The campaign transforms sweaters from a seasonal staple into the foundation of personal style, highlighting how texture, layering, and originality come […]...
